name: How long does a typical bathroom vanity installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom vanity installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom vanity installation typically takes 1 to 3 days, depending on the scope of work. This includes removing the old vanity, preparing the area, installing the new cabinet, countertop, sink, and connecting plumbing. If electrical work for new outlets or lighting is involved, or if extensive tile work or flooring repair is needed, the project duration can extend. We strive to provide clear timelines after an initial assessment, ensuring process clarity and minimizing disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical bathroom vanity installation takes 1-3 days, but can be longer with additional plumbing, electrical, or tiling work.
